orders.text:
A.O. No.264 of 2012
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr Piyush Garg, Advocate holding brief of 
Mr Bindesh Kumar Gupta, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
 Mr Hari Mohan Bhatia, Advocate for the 
respondent nos.1 to 5/caveators. 
(Delay Condonation Appl. No.5791 of 2012)
 Heard. 
 Grounds shown in the affidavit filed in 
support of delay condonation application are 
sufficient to allow the delay condonation 
application. Delay in filing the appeal is hereby 
condoned. Delay condonation application is 
allowed. 
A.O. No.264 of 2012
 Heard. 
 Admit the appeal. 
 Issue notice to the respondents 7 & 8. 
 List this appeal after six weeks alongwith 
Appeal No.141 of 2012. 
(Stay Application No.5792 of 2012) 
Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties, it is directed that till next date of listing, 
execution of the award dated 23.02.2012 passed 
by Motor Accident Claim Tribunal/District 
Judge, Pauri Garhwal in M.A.C.P. No.38 of 
2004, Smt. Sateshwari Devi and Others vs. Shiv 
Dayal Singh & Others shall remain stayed, 
provided appellant deposits `3,50,000/-of the 
awarded amount before the Motor Accident 
Claims Tribunal concerned within a period of six 
weeks from today. The amount already deposited 
under the statutory provisions shall be adjusted. 
   
Registry is directed to remit the entire sum, 
deposited under the statutory provision, to the 
Tribunal concerned within two weeks from 
today. The amount so remitted by this Court as 
well as the amount deposited by the appellant in 
compliance of this order, shall be invested by the 
Tribunal in a fixed deposit so that it could earn 
interest and would be subject to further orders of 
this Court. 
 Stay application stands disposed of. 
 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 26.07.2012 
Arti

A.O. No. 264 of 2012 
Hon’ble B.S.Verma,J
(Money Withdrawal application No.10385 of 2012) 
Sri Bindesh Kumar Gupta, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Sri Hari Mohan Bhatia, Advocate for the 
respondent Nos.1 to 6/claimants. 
This is money withdrawal application 
No.10385 of 2012 moved on behalf of 
claimant/respondent Nos. 1 to 6 praying for 
withdrawal of awarded amount, deposited by the 
appellant before the MACT concerned. 
Heard. 
This Money withdrawal application is 
allowed only to this extent that Claimant/ 
respondent Nos.1 to 5 are permitted to withdraw 
50% of the amount deposited by the appellant 
before MACT concerned, as per their shares. So far 
as the claimant/respondent No. 6 (minor) is 
concerned, his money withdrawal application is 
dismissed. Rest of the amount shall be kept in 
Fixed Deposit Interest Earning Scheme. 
Money withdrawal application stands 
disposed of. 
List this appeal in the week commencing 
29.10.2012 alongwith connected matters. 
 
 (B.S. Verma, J) 
JKJ 09.10.2012
